_what: Stack declaration for mock3's codelines, in the shape orchestrations/plugins/dependency-scan-plugin.js reads (REQUIRED_KEYS). The previous version described the stack as {packageManager, manifest, lockfile} per codeline — a shape nothing consumes — so every writer attempt logged 'dependency declaration is incomplete' and the scan never ran. Both codelines are the same npm + typescript + vitest stack, so one declaration covers them.
